reviews.title: Fast, and works as expected.
reviews.comment: I've used this for a few weeks now and it seems to perform quite well. It's fast and works as expected. I installed it into a new Alienware PC that came with one NVMe SSD and had a slot free for a second one. I decided to get this as a second drive to store some of my games rather than filling up the primary drive to 75% capacity and needing to upgrade later. Installation was as easy as any other M.2 drive, just plug it into the port and screw in the retaining screw. It's fully compatible with Windows, the Disk Management utility created the volume and formatted it with no problems. It was a good purchase.
reviews.author: Robert Carnevali
